note: WGCNA module ASSIGNMENT on the single genuine rat bulk cohort (n=12, n=4 per primary contrast). Module PRESERVATION across an independent dataset was NOT assessed because no independent bulk NP cohort exists; the Langfelder et al. (2011) Z-summary therefore was not computed. The earlier MC5_WGCNA_Preservation.csv (Z_summary = 1.0 for all modules) was forged by comparing GSE217932 against its own duplicate GSE186237 and has been deleted.
method: Signed WGCNA, Spearman correlation, soft-threshold beta=6, top 5000 variable genes, min module size=30 (original pipeline_mc5 run on GSE217932 only)
interpretation: Exploratory; modules are descriptive and not replicated.
caution: n=12 total (n=4 per contrast) limits reliability; interpret qualitatively.
